bounded_scope.normal_checks: Native registers, complete 2 MiB scratchpad at program boundaries, both dataset items and final digest match in each completed 2x1 profile.

capacity.full_default_hardware_hash: Not executed; requires a separately reviewed transaction namespace extension or quiescent rotation.
capacity.reservation: Whole-batch admission burns the reservation. Cancel/completion do not refund it. Renewal requires externally quiescent hard reset.

classification: Sanitized derivative summary, not an original runner receipt or a re-signed journal.

derivation.arithmetic: Actual per-return CSV rows and JSON ledgers; checked stage/nested sums, native item addresses, item equations and digest equality. Completed command records and raw PASS lines gate the listed results.
derivation.omissions: Private paths, raw journal/input/output hashes and execution IDs, timestamps, host/process dumps, raw traces, binaries and netlists remain in the preserved local originals. This summary publishes technical results and public-source identities only.

mapping.scope: Service bridge plus unchanged item/executor/multipliers; no whole lifecycle mapping or physical PPA.

native_reference.counter_scope: Direct unchanged native initial fill/program/interprogram/finalization work supplies gold outside callback counts; callback statistics do not time that direct setup.

nested_clock_interpretation.availability_vs_phase: item_cycles/request_to_first_response measures accepted item request to first offered response. Occupied phase bins include return/handoff edges. For these two items, item-phase sum and dataset wait equal availability sum + 2; they are not interchangeable.
nested_clock_interpretation.nesting: Service-phase sums close the outer execution partition. Item and dataset counters are nested and never added again to the outer total.
